---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: brine-gate-config
  namespace: edge
data:
  RATE: "50"
  REGION: north
  TIMEOUT_MS: "2500"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: brine-gate
  namespace: edge
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: brine-gate
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: edge
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: brine-gate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: brine-gate
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: edge
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: brine-gate
          image: "registry.example.net/edge/brine:5.2.0"
          ports:
            - name: api
              containerPort: 9090
          env:
            - name: RATE
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: brine-gate-config
                  key: RATE
            - name: REGION
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: brine-gate-config
                  key: REGION
            - name: API_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: brine-tls-pin
                  key: token
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: "1Gi"
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: api
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8081
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/brine-gate
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: brine-gate-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: brine-gate
  namespace: edge
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: brine-gate
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: edge
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: brine-gate
  ports:
    - name: main
      port: 443
      targetPort: 9091
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: brine-gate
  namespace: edge
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
    - host: gate.edge.example.net
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: brine-gate
                port:
                  number: 443
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: brine-gate
  namespace: edge
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: brine-gate
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 9
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 60
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: brine-gate
  namespace: edge
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: brine-gate
